question: What product did SlideUpLift launch in August 2026?

hits.title: SlideUpLift launches Creatos AI, the AI presentation maker that never starts from a blank page.
hits.snippet: [launches | 2026-08-14] SlideUpLift launched Creatos AI on Aug 14th '26. Jersey City, N.J., Aug. 14, 2026 - SlideUpLift, a presentation platform trusted by more than 100,000 professionals, today announced the launch of Creatos AI, an AI presentation maker built on SlideUpLift's library of more than 40,000 professionally designed slides.
hits.summary: SlideUpLift launched Creatos AI on Aug 14th '26.
